note: Page configuration, not a record. The proof strip on the home page and the lab on a page (lab launch, 2026-10-24). Claim texts hold no digits and no number words; each {name} is a value read from the cited experiment record by a JSON pointer (scripts/lab-pages.mjs renderLabProof) and linked to it, and the build checks the rendered strip with scripts/number-provenance.mjs. A claim's record must be a measured experiment record with a decided verdict (briefProblems refuses the router-arm records). Brokers appear by the letters their published records use; no provider is named. Plain-language home (2026-11-16): each claim also carries a `limit` in words, shown under it as "Limit:" on the home and the lab on a page; a limit, like a text, holds no digit and no number word, and every claim on this list must have one. Glossary links (2026-11-16): a claim's `glossary` maps a phrase of its text to an entry of the glossary on the methods page (methods/#glossary-<entry>); on the home page only, that phrase links there where it is first used (scripts/lab-pages.mjs fillClaim).

claims.text: Paying more for AI code review bought little. On a sealed set of private code changes, the cheapest reviewer cost {cheapCost} a review and caught {cheapCaught} of {cheapOf} planted defects; the most expensive cost {dearCost} and caught {dearCaught} of {dearOf}. The uncertainty ranges of all the reviewers overlap, so none was clearly ahead.
claims.limit: Our own changes and planted defects, reviewed without tools; a catch means the right file was flagged. Cost is what the reseller billed.

claims.text: Resellers of model access (brokers) served the model we asked for, at different prices. We sent {calls} identical requests at the same moment: {subS} were silently swapped to another model for {modelS} and {subM} for {modelM}. Broker A and Broker C charged list price; Broker B charged more, a price spread of {spreadS} on each model.
claims.limit: Only the resellers we use, within minutes on that morning; some requests got no answer. Resellers are named by letter.

claims.text: A negative result stays published. Can an AI reviewer talk itself out of its own false alarms? Against a pass mark we wrote down in advance, the answer was {decision}: with a self-check step, its false alarms on clean changes stayed at {faA} and {faB} in its separate runs.
claims.limit: The reviewer model named in the record, on our own private changes; other models may differ. The diagnosis itself is not checked.
